units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 3:11">Targ. Cant. III, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:5:3">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לינן חזרין וכָלְלִין לון</he> do we not again combine them (the separated portions)?
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 5:13">Targ. Ps. V, 13</cite>.

senses.gloss: (v. כִּילָה, כִּילְתָא I) to prepare a bridal room.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 101b:12">B. Mets. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>כַּלְּלֵיה לבריח</he> if the owner of the rented dwelling gave it to his son as a bridal room (Rashi: if he was making preparations for his son’s wedding, and needed the dwelling for the young couple).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70">Gen. R. s. 70</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 125:3">Yalk. Gen. 125</cite> <he>כולי יומא הוו מְכַלְּלִין</he> (<cite ref="B00537"><he>ביה</he></cite>) <he>ליה</he> the whole day they were helping him to prepare the bridal chamber (decorating it).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 65:12">Targ. Ps. LXV, 12</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 103:4">Ib. CIII, 4</cite>; a. e.—[<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:11">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>מכלליה</he>, read: <he>מכלי להו</he>, v. <cite ref="K00717"><he>כְּלֵי</he> I</cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be crowned, to adorn one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Psalms 142:8">Ps. CXLII, 8</cite>) <he>יִתְכַּלְּלוּן בי וכ׳</he> the righteous shall adorn themselves with me.

senses.gloss: to be led into the bridal room, be married.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 27b:22">Meg. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>כי איכ׳ רבה וכ׳</he> when his son R. was to marry.
